name: flutter-store-ready
description: Store-release toolkit for mobile apps: /flutter-store-ready builds and hardens Flutter apps (adapting to BLoC, Provider, Riverpod, classic Material and monorepos); /store-review runs automated pre-submission audits; /store-forms drafts Data safety and App Privacy answers; /store-rejection turns an Apple or Google rejection into a fix and a reply. Automated checks across Flutter, Expo, React Native and Native Android/iOS.
